act_title: The Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act, 1960
title: Penalty for practising phooka or doom dev.―If any person performs upon any cow or other
text:
12. Penalty for practising phooka or doom dev.―If any person performs upon any cow or other

milch animal the operation called phooka or [doom dev or any other operation (including injection of
any substance) to improve lactation which is injurious to the health of the animal] or permits such
